item.title: Blake Lively's Met Gala stunt after Justin Baldoni settlement was a 'deliberately calculated tactic': experts
item.description: Branding experts told Fox News Digital that Blake Lively's Met Gala appearance after settling her lawsuit with Justin Baldoni was a brilliantly executed strategic move.

item.title: SIM swap scam drained Florida woman's bank account in minutes
item.description: SIM swap scams let hackers steal your phone number and drain accounts in minutes. Learn how one woman was targeted and how to protect yourself.

item.title: NYPD releases footage of 4 suspects wanted in hate-fueled graffiti spree defacing homes, Holocaust memorial
item.description: The NYPD released surveillance footage of four people wanted in connection to an antisemitic graffiti spree targeting Queens' Jewish community.
